hypotheses: image-only burst selection with glare suspicion
grouping: Every page/variant of a statement, invoice template/specimen, and MIDV specimen/device/session stays DEV. No TRAIN inference, no cross-device generalization claim. Existing FATURA TRAIN layouts are unused.
camera_conditions: original camera images only, no added degradation

burst.synthetic: each document's dark, glare, motion_blur; cyclic first frame chosen by specimen SHA256 modulo three
burst.camera: two ordered existing frames per specimen and capture condition
burst.candidate: maximum frozen image-only selection score; first wins ties; no OCR or truth used

timing: separate interleaved single-worker paired baseline/candidate pass; 3 repeats; first manifest page per each of 5 invoice layouts and 3 statements, dark condition; no browser claim
selection_gate: No clean token or exact-field loss and no new wrong-accept frame on real DEV; report every stratum and paired regression. A positive aggregate alone cannot promote a candidate. Latency is descriptive research timing, main bench and phone gate remain required.
failures: empty predictions, fixed denominators; never select next-best successful burst member after failure
rights: Existing author-published MIT Bankstatemently, CC-BY-4.0 FATURA, CC-BY-SA-2.5 MIDV specimens; original procedural degradations. No new weights/data acquisition. Raw data, text and per-specimen camera outcomes stay owner-private outside git.
